description: This file defines a comprehensive implementation for interacting with OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) APIs in the context of language models. It includes classes and functions for request signing (both with OCI SDK signers and manual credentials), request transformation, response handling for different vendor formats, streaming support, error handling, and utility functions for message and tool definition conversions. It also provides integration points for logging and context management, aiming to facilitate secure, flexible, and vendor-specific API communication for large language models.

classes.name: OCIRequestWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for HTTP requests compatible with OCI signer interface, encapsulating method, URL, headers, body, and path.

classes.name: OCIChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OCI API interactions, encompassing request signing, parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, and streaming support.

classes.name: OCIStreamWrapper
classes.description: A custom stream wrapper for OCI streaming responses, capable of parsing chunked data and handling vendor-specific formats.
